display.purpose: Screen titles, always in the serif.

title.purpose: Sheet and section titles, in the serif.

body.purpose: All copy and form input text; the 16px floor.

metric.purpose: The one number that matters most on a row (days since water), mono for tabular alignment.

code.purpose: Plant codes and other short machine-produced strings, mono.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The undo toast only — the sole element in the system allowed to float above the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The WATER button — the one loud, filled action on a plant screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.455 0.104 236); color: oklch(0.985 0.004 85); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.455 0.098 152); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The default, unopinionated button — transparent fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.8 0.012 80); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.255 0.014 65); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-outline:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.455 0.098 152); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Narrows a list. 36px — below the touch floor on purpose, since a mis-tap only changes what you're looking at.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.8 0.012 80); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.51 0.014 68); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-chip:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.455 0.098 152); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip--selected { border-color: transparent; background: oklch(0.255 0.014 65); color: oklch(0.968 0.008 85); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip__count { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.655 0.012 72); } .ds-chip--selected .ds-chip__count { color: inherit; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The shared 48px-tall field every text/number/date input is built from.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 48px; width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.8 0.012 80); background: oklch(0.995 0.003 85); padding: 0 14px; color: oklch(0.255 0.014 65); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.655 0.012 72); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.455 0.098 152); outline: none; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: A desktop sidebar entry; active state gets a tinted fill rather than a bar or underline.
components.html: Today3
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; color: oklch(0.51 0.014 68); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.944 0.01 85); } .ds-nav-item__label { flex: 1; } .ds-nav-item__count { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: oklch(0.655 0.012 72); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: oklch(0.944 0.026 152); color: oklch(0.455 0.098 152); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-item__count { color: inherit; }

narrative.overview:
Florarithm reads like a herbarium record card crossed with an accounting ledger: square-cornered, typed rather than drawn, and quiet by default so that the one fact worth noticing — a plant is thirsty, a task is done — is the only thing that speaks. Names are set in a serif, like a specimen label; everything a machine produced (codes, dates, day counts) is set in mono so columns of numbers line up without effort. Color is treated as ink applied for meaning, not decoration: leaf and water sit at the same lightness and chroma so neither competes with the other, and warmth (ember) is the only color allowed to be louder, because a warning that is exactly as loud as everything else has stopped being a warning.

The system rejects anything that reads as playful, glossy, or gamified. There are no gradients, no drop shadows on resting surfaces, no rounded-everything softness — chips are the sole exception, and that exception is meaningful. Density and warmth come from a slightly warm, low-chroma paper tone rather than from ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Square-ish, ledger-like forms; roundness is reserved for chips alone.
Serif for what a person named; mono for what a machine recorded.
One saturated color per meaning, never color for its own sake.
Flat at rest; the only shadow in the system belongs to an ephemeral toast.
Warm, low-chroma parchment neutrals rather than true gray or true white.

rules.name: The One Loud Color Rule
rules.body: Only ember is allowed to sit at a visibly higher chroma than its siblings. Every other accent is tuned to match leaf and water's lightness and chroma exactly, so urgency is never accidentally implied by a color choice alone.

rules.name: The Specimen Label Rule
rules.body: A plant's own name is always set in Newsreader; nothing else in the interface is. If it's a name someone gave a living thing, it gets the serif — everything else, including a screen title for a non-plant screen, uses the interface sans or mono instead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If it's still on screen a second from now, it has no shadow. Shadows are reserved for things that are about to disappear.

rules.name: The One Round Thing Rule
rules.body: Full roundness is reserved for chips. If a new component needs to feel selectable-and-transient the way a chip does, it can round fully; anything that holds or writes data stays square-ish.

dos: Do put a plant's own name in Newsreader and machine-produced data (codes, dates, day counts) in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep leaf and water visually equal in weight; let ember alone carry extra urgency.
Do use a -tint color for a "this already happened, calm down" state instead of a second confirmation UI.
Do keep every control that writes data at least 44px tall (touch) and every text input at 16px, full stop.
donts: Don't add a shadow to anything that stays on screen — shadows are reserved for the undo toast alone.
Don't round anything fully except chips; a rounded data field or button reads as off-system.
Don't introduce a fourth saturated accent color; every meaning in the app is already assigned to leaf, water, or ember.
Don't style a component with passed-in utility classes for anything but placement (margin, width, visibility) — look comes from variant/size/tone props only.
